name: Yasuharu Takanashi
bio: Yasuharu Takanashi is a Japanese composer. He composed music for Falcom games in the early 90s, before turning to anime songs at the end of the 90s. In 2003 he debuted as soundtrack composer for anime. He is known for composing the music for many popular shounen anime such as Naruto Shippuuden, Fairy Tail and the Beyblade series.
